_review_fixes: Review of 2d87900..54a0e49, fixes in 79b2d9f (see the clips marked 'review fix' and _timing 5-8). Checks after the fixes, reviewer's tools (leftcmp2.py / lcdiff2.py) against his base traces of 2d87900: LEFT arena, today's version, 180 steps: 185 of 186 actions bit-identical (sim log, sheet frame, canvas hashes, transforms, DOM count); the one difference is the same as before the fixes - sting_hyp, one overlay canvas on 11 frames (steps 88-103); it stays when the new Sting hook is switched off and is absent in the «вчера» run, so it comes from state shared between the arenas, not from the left arena's code - cause not found. «вчера» version, 150 steps, arenas L + M + R: 186 of 186 identical. Console: no errors except the old izanami_hyp one (BASE[name] is not a function - present on 2d87900 too). Reviewer's stress.py (fast clicks, version / god switch mid-action, speeds, auto-repeat): no stuck hold / wait / transform, 0 errors. Not done: the reviewer's findings file (findings.md) was not on the machine, the fixes were made from the lead's summary; findings 13, 14, 16 could be identified only as far as the Sting hook timeout (fixed) - the other two were not looked at. Findings 4, 5, 9, 15, 17 are for the owner / later work.
_timing: Block 1 (new arenas, today's new sheets, focus god only; live arena and «вчера» sheets unchanged): (1) STG.playAnim: sheet duration D = clamp(max(hitAt/rel, floor), .3, max) with floor 1.25 s strike / 1.5 s super+ult and max 1.7 / 2.0. (2) When the release frame D*rel comes later than the script expects (hitAt; .5 for OLD_SIG supers/ults; REL_NEW; leapAt), fx2 calls BR.hold(lag): app.js stops stepping the sim and fx2 of THAT arena for lag seconds while the sprites keep playing (scriptDt in tick/stepManual). So the whole script of the action - anticipation, leap, launch, projectiles, pending hits, damage numbers - runs lag later; order and all sim values are unchanged; nothing else acts on the stand during that time. Lag is 0.06-0.56 s (median 0.23 s; Susanoo BT ult 0.85 s). (3) Strikes whose release frame is too early even at the slowest playback (>0.08 s before the expected moment: Brynhild, Indra, Zeus TI, Heimdall, Ra BT atk): the sheet starts later by that gap (idle pose until then), nothing else moves. (4) LEAP_NEW leap (Brynhild) is fast: starts 0.31 s before the strike instead of at 0.03 s. (5) Review fix (finding 10): auto-repeat and showcase keep the intervals they had before r9 (2.3 / 2.9 / 3.3 s and 2.5 / 3.0 / 3.4 s; all three arenas restart together). Only while a new arena that held its script is still in its action when the interval ends (sheet on screen, effects alive or hits pending), the next trigger waits until that arena has had the full interval of script time - at most its hold (Lu Bu ult: 3.3 + 0.27 s). So the left arena's repeat cadence is as before except in that case, where its pause between repeats grows by up to the hold; its action itself never changes. (6) Review fix (finding 2): a hit series that ends up to .45 s after its sheet stretches the rest of the sheet to the last hit (Wukong super) instead of restarting it. (7) Review fix (finding 8): Heimdall TI strike - the leap back waits for the end of the second baked swing (home at 1.23 s instead of 0.83 s). (8) Review fix (finding 6): r9Link projectiles land .01 s before the damage (flight .14 s where the release frame is .15 s before the hit).
